about_the_game:
Meet the hero no one asked for but everyone needed — Someone’s Dad! 🍺
Armed with a glorious beer belly, Union Jack underpants, and an unshakable sense of misplaced confidence, he’s ready to reclaim the streets one awkward dance move at a time. He might not be a knight, but he’s definitely a legend.

This Supporter Edition also includes all the characters from the Medieval Legends Pack, featuring a full roster of historical heroes to balance out the chaos.

A heartfelt thanks to everyone backing the project — your support keeps the fun (and the dad jokes) alive!
